edges.label: evidence

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Government recommends suspending Web Summit on Wednesday; the decision rests with the organisers ("Já emitimos a nossa recomendação de que os trabalhos desse evento possam suspender-se")

edges.label: evidence

edges.label: evidence

edges.label: evidence

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: CP suppresses four trains crossing the 25 de Abril bridge in what it calls the most critical window; CP says «as previsões meteorológicas para o período entre as 12:00 e as 15:00» point to heavy rain and strong wind (CP does not name the forecaster)

edges.label: evidence

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: ANA: operations at Madeira airport conditioned on 11 Nov; cancellations expected
